label: Client certificate
type: the X.509 certificate a client presents so that Couchbase Server can authenticate it without a password. The mechanism behind auth-mechanism:x509-certificate.
note: See cert:node-certificate. Note this is the concrete machinery of an auth-mechanism, so the same fact is reachable from the identity family and the crypto family - the registry states it once, as cert:trust-store verifiesIdentityOf cert:client-certificate.
